sources.title: Iraqi eVisa country selector endpoint
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Republic of Iraq eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Iraq eVisa API is served from the Ministry of Interior eVisa domain and is the nationality selector used by the public service.

sources.title: Iraqi Electronic Visa: Visa Types and Instructions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Republic of Iraq eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live federal Iraqi Ministry of Interior eVisa service describes visa processing and its country/passport-type requirement search.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Search for visa requirements by your country and passport type.

sources.title: Electronic Visa
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of Iraq in Los Angeles, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Iraqi Foreign Ministry mission directs applicants to the federal electronic-visa platform but provides no nationality eligibility cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Apply for an entry visa to Iraq electronically through the Iraqi electronic visa platform.

sources.title: Foreigners Residence Law No. 76 of 2017
sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice, Republic of Iraq
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Justice publishes the federal Foreigners Residence Law, which preserves distinct treatment for specified persons and documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The provisions of this law shall not be applied to Iraqis and their children who hold foreign passports.
